name: damage-timing
summary: Independently recorded Health before/after a frost dash against a tracked hostile thief, plus a frost-dash-off control. Bridge get responses in trace.jsonl are the record.
notes: Acceptance procedure — not run. Outstanding check from the 2026-09-07 catalog live audit: ring recipe gameplayHits numbers were agent-reported; raw bridge responses/timestamps were not saved.
Every get is a bridge call the rig writes to trace.jsonl. Records: before, after, controlBefore, controlAfter (Health of @tracked:bandit).

Expected shape, not a claimed magnitude: after a tinted dash the thief Health.Value is lower than before. After the control dash with frost dash off, controlAfter is not a nova-sized drop relative to controlBefore. Per-hit attribution unresolved — this does not prove the ring (versus dash, DoT, or another unit) dealt the damage.
The thief is tracked and left for the rig's cleanup and remainingTestEntities check. Do not skipCleanupFor.
No exists step on frost rings; they are not spawned by this case.
